# Sealmetrics Privacy Policy

**Last updated:** 24 September 2026
**Version:** 4.0 (draft; replaces the page published at sealmetrics.com/privacy on 21 September 2026 and v3.0 in this repository)

---

## 1. Who we are and what this policy covers

**Sealmetrics S.L.** (Tax ID ESB70933239), Carrer de Tirso de Molina 36, 08940 Cornellà de Llobregat, Barcelona, Spain ("Sealmetrics", "we") provides an audience measurement and web analytics service to businesses ("Customers").

We process personal data in two different roles:

| Role | Who it affects | Sections |
|---|---|---|
| **Controller** | Visitors to sealmetrics.com; people who register for or use the my.sealmetrics.com platform (Customers' users); people invited to an account; people who view a shared dashboard; people who request the AI brand report or use the Data Studio connector; business contacts, customers, contract signatories and professionals we contact for prospecting | 2 to 12 |
| **Processor** (on behalf of the Customer) | Visitors to our Customers' websites | 13 |

**Privacy contact:** privacy@sealmetrics.com. We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer. Privacy matters are handled at that address.

---

## 2. sealmetrics.com (our website)

**Forms.** When you write to us or request information, we process the data you provide: name, email, company and your website URL. The purpose is to reply to you and handle your request, and the legal basis is your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f)). We keep submissions for 24 months, unless you ask us to erase them sooner.

**Our own audience measurement.** On sealmetrics.com we use our own Sealmetrics script, with no third-party tools. It works exactly as described in section 13:

- it does not set cookies or store anything on your device;
- to count visits, it reads technical characteristics of your browser and computes a pseudonymised session identifier that changes every day;
- it processes pages viewed, duration, referrer and approximate country (inferred from the time zone).

The purpose is to measure our site's audience and the effectiveness of our marketing. It relies on the consent exemption for audience measurement tools (guidance of the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD), January 2024) and on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).

**No cookies on sealmetrics.com.** The website does not set cookies or third-party pixels.

---

## 3. Sign-up process on my.sealmetrics.com

The same in-house script runs **only** during the sign-up process (account creation, plan selection, email verification and organisation creation). Once you have logged in, nothing is measured.

It records the pages viewed and the steps completed, with the chosen plan and billing interval as the only attributes. Your email, name, company and user or organisation identifiers are **never** sent to it.

Basis: the audience measurement exemption and our legitimate interest in improving the sign-up process (Art. 6(1)(f)).

**Bot verification.** On the registration form we use **Cloudflare Turnstile** (Cloudflare, Inc.) to prevent automated sign-ups. Cloudflare processes technical data about your connection and browser, such as your IP address, for that check. Basis: our legitimate interest in protecting the service against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f)).

---

## 4. Cookies and storage on the platform

When you log in to my.sealmetrics.com, **three strictly necessary cookies** are set:

| Cookie | Purpose | Duration |
|---|---|---|
| `sm_access_token` | Keep your session authenticated | 15 minutes (renewed while you use the platform) |
| `sm_refresh_token` | Renew the session without asking for your password again | 7 days |
| `sm_csrf` | Protect against cross-site request forgery | 7 days |

- They are sent only over encrypted connections and are deleted when you log out.
- They have no analytics, advertising or profiling purpose.
- They are exempt from consent (Art. 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive and Art. 22.2 of the LSSI (Spanish Information Society Services Act)) because they are strictly necessary for a service you request.

In addition, the platform stores some operating preferences in your **browser's local storage** (localStorage): the selected organisation, active filters and segments, the state of the sign-up process and, if you use it, your API key for the dashboard. They are necessary to provide the service you request and are not sent to third parties.

### 5.2 Invitees

If a user invites you to their organisation, we process your email and the name of the person inviting you in order to send you the invitation. Basis: legitimate interest of the Customer inviting you (Art. 6(1)(f)).

- If you do not accept, the invitation expires.
- **We do not use your email for marketing communications** unless and until you register.

### 5.3 Accounts created by an AI agent

An AI assistant may create an account on your behalf (for example, from Claude or another MCP client) and give us your email. In that case your data does not come from you, but from the agent acting on your behalf (Art. 14 GDPR):

- we send you an email with a link to claim the account;
- you will be able to review and expressly accept the Terms and the DPA on your first access *(rollout in progress)*.

If you do not claim the account, you can ask us to delete it at privacy@sealmetrics.com.

### 5.4 Shared dashboards

If a Customer shares a dashboard via a link, when you open it we record the IP address, browser, referring page and access date. The purpose is the security of the link and letting the Customer know it has been used. Basis: legitimate interest of the Customer and ours (Art. 6(1)(f)). Retention: 90 days *(automatic enforcement: rollout in progress)*.

### 5.5 Customers coming from Shopify

If you install our app from Shopify, we receive from Shopify your store domain, the account email and the data needed for billing through Shopify. We use them to create your account, link the store and bill you. Basis: contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).

### 5.6 Marketing communications

If you register on the platform, we may email you news about Sealmetrics and services similar to those you have subscribed to. Basis: Art. 21.2 LSSI and our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).

- You can object in the registration form itself.
- You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email or by writing to privacy@sealmetrics.com.
- We **only** send these communications to registered users and to people who have expressly consented (for example, in the brand report form, section 6). Never to invited people who have not registered.
- The emails are sent through **Resend** (section 9).
- We keep your email on the list until you unsubscribe. After unsubscribing we keep only what is needed not to email you again.

### 5.7 Service improvement

We do not measure what you do inside the platform once you have logged in (section 3). To improve the service we use aggregated technical usage data (for example, number of API calls or errors), not your individual activity.

## 6. AI brand monitoring report

The form at `/ai-brand-monitoring` asks fifteen AI models six questions about a company and emails the answers to the requester.

- **Data:** your work email, the brand you are asking about and, if you provide them, its sector and competitors. We do not ask for your name. The report is about organisations, not people.
- **Purposes and bases:**
  - (a) preparing and sending you the report (Art. 6(1)(b));
  - (b) keeping a record of the request to prevent abuse and handle enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f));
  - (c) occasionally sending you reports and news, **only if you tick the optional box** (Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 21 LSSI). You can withdraw that consent at any time.
- **Recipients:**
  - **Cloudflare, Inc.:** performs the bot check (Turnstile), receives the form and generates the PDF. For the PDF it receives the report, never your email.
  - **Enroutia:** the model routing platform. It receives the brand, sector, competitors and a random reference, never your email.
  - **The AI models:** receive only the brand, sector and competitors. Some are served from the USA.
  - **Resend, Inc. (USA):** delivers the report and, if you consented, the occasional emails.
- **Retention:**
  - Request record: 24 months.
  - Link between the reference and your email: deleted when the report is delivered, or after 72 hours at most.
  - Occasional email list: until you unsubscribe.

---

### 6.1 Downloadable sector studies

On some pages we publish studies of what AI models say about a sector, such as [the one on Mallorca hotels](/es/ai-brand-monitoring/hoteles-mallorca/) (in Spanish). The full report of each study is requested with your email address, and we send it to you by email.

- **Data:** your email address and the study you ask for. We do not ask for your name. We note whether the address belongs to a free email provider, to tell apart the requests that come from companies.
- **Purposes and bases:**
  - (a) sending you the study, because you asked for it (Art. 6(1)(b));
  - (b) keeping a record of the request to prevent abuse and handle enquiries (Art. 6(1)(f));
  - (c) occasionally sending you studies and news, **only if you tick the optional box** (Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 21 LSSI). Not ticking it does not affect the study, and you can withdraw that consent at any time.
- **Recipients:**
  - **Cloudflare, Inc.:** performs the bot check (Turnstile) and receives the form.
  - **Resend, Inc. (USA):** delivers the study and, if you consented, the occasional emails. It fetches the PDF from sealmetrics.com; the PDF contains no data about you.
  - Neither Enroutia nor the AI models receive anything: the study is done before you ask for it.
- **Retention:**
  - Request record: 24 months.
  - Occasional email list: until you unsubscribe.

## 7. Data Studio connector and Google user data

The Sealmetrics connector for Data Studio is a Google Apps Script that lets Customers load their Sealmetrics analytics into their Data Studio reports. It requests a single Google permission, `script.external_request`, which it uses exclusively to call the Sealmetrics API.

- **Data accessed:** it does not read data from your Google account (name, email, contacts, Drive, Sheets or other services). It only handles what you enter in Data Studio (your Sealmetrics API key, the site and the report type) and the date range and fields of each chart.
- **Use:** only to authenticate against the Sealmetrics API and return the analytics you request to your report. It is not used for advertising, profiling or model training, and it is never sold.
- **Sharing:** it is sent only to the Sealmetrics API, operated by Sealmetrics S.L. in the EU.
- **Protection:**
  - everything travels encrypted over HTTPS;
  - API keys are stored only as a SHA-256 hash, can be restricted to read-only and to specific sites, and are revoked in Settings › API Keys.
- **Retention:** Sealmetrics does not store data from your Google account. The connector keeps responses in the Apps Script cache for a maximum of 15 minutes. You can revoke access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
- **Limited use:** the use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

## 8. Business management, prospecting and contracts

We process business contact data of people who work for companies: name, job title, company, business email and phone, public professional profile and the history of our relationship.

| Purpose | Legal basis | Retention |
|---|---|---|
| **Managing customers and people interested in Sealmetrics** (CRM): sales follow-up, proposals, meetings | Pre-contractual steps and contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) and legitimate interest in managing our business relationships (Art. 6(1)(f)) | Contacts who do not become customers: **24 months from the last contact**. Customers: for the duration of the relationship and then **blocked for 5 years** (art. 32 LOPDGDD) |
| **B2B prospecting**: contacting professionals at companies that may be interested in our service | Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)), with a documented assessment. Business data only; never special categories | **24 months from the last contact** |
| **Electronic signature of contracts** | Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) and legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)) | End of the contract + **6 years** (art. 30 of the Spanish Commercial Code) |

- **Where prospecting data comes from:** public professional sources and B2B data providers (Clay). In our first message we tell you where we obtained your contact details and how to object (Art. 14 GDPR).
- **Objection:** if you tell us you do not want to be contacted, we stop and keep only your email address on a suppression list, for as long as needed to respect your decision.
- **Tools:** our CRM, internal automations and contract signing are hosted by Sealmetrics on **Hetzner** servers in the EU. For prospecting we use **Clay** (search and enrichment of professional data) and **lemlist** (sending the messages). See section 9.

## 10. International transfers

- **Data about visitors to our Customers' websites** (section 13) is processed **only in the EU**.
- **Resend, Stripe, Cloudflare, Google and Clay** process data about platform users, people who use our forms or prospecting contacts. These providers may transfer it to the USA with the following safeguards:
  - the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, for certified providers;
  - the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
- **Shopify** processes data about the stores using its platform under its own safeguards.
- **Brand report:** some AI models are served from the USA, but they do not receive personal data.

---

## 11. Security

We apply technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk:

- encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+);
- passwords stored as hashes;
- encryption of application secrets (API keys and integration credentials);
- two-factor authentication available;
- role-based access control and isolation of each Customer's data;
- automatic retention periods in the analytics database;
- backups;
- monitoring and alerting.

Details for Customers are in Annex 2 of the DPA. **We do not hold third-party certifications** (such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2).

## 12. Your rights

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and withdraw at any time any consent you have given. Write to **privacy@sealmetrics.com**; we will reply within one month. We do not take decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects concerning you.

You can lodge a complaint with the **Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD)** (www.aepd.es) or with the supervisory authority of your EU country of residence.

## 13. Visitors to our Customers' websites

In this case **the controller is the Customer** (the site you are visiting) and Sealmetrics acts as its processor under the DPA. You should address your rights to the Customer; if you write to us, we will forward your request to them.

### 13.1 How it works

- **No cookies or storage on your device:** no localStorage, sessionStorage or IndexedDB.
- **Session identifier:**
  - to count visits, the measurement code **reads technical characteristics of your browser** (browser type, languages, time zone, screen and device capabilities) and computes a session identifier on the fly;
  - on our servers that identifier is **pseudonymised** with a secret key and a random value that **is destroyed every day**;
  - it does not make it possible to recognise you from one day to the next or across different sites, and we do not build profiles with it.
  - Even so, while it exists it is **pseudonymised personal data**, not anonymous data.
- **Country:** inferred from your browser's time zone, not from your IP address.
- **IP address:**
  - it arrives with every request, as with any internet connection, and is used transiently to filter abusive traffic;
  - it **is not stored in the analytics database** and is not available to Customers;
  - it may remain in the internal processing queues until consumed and, if processing fails, in retry queues for up to 7 days.
- **Advertising click identifiers** (gclid, fbclid…): used on the fly to determine which network the click came from; their value is not stored.
- **Bot and agent detection (only if the Customer has enabled it):** additional technical browser signals and interaction patterns are also analysed, and the country and network are looked up from the IP address (MaxMind GeoLite2 offline database), solely to classify the visit as human or automated.
- **Shopify integration:** to attribute purchases, the session identifier is added to the cart and becomes associated with the order in the Customer's store.

### 13.2 Legal basis

- **Reading browser characteristics:** relies on the consent exemption for audience measurement tools (Art. 22.2 LSSI and AEPD guidance of January 2024), because it is used solely to produce statistics for the site you are visiting.
- **Processing of the data:** based on the Customer's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)). Each Customer must inform you in its own privacy policy; we provide them with a model text.

### 13.3 Retention

| Data | Period |
|---|---|
| State of the ongoing session | 2 hours |
| Random pseudonymisation value | 24 hours; then destroyed |
| Technical log of each event | 1 day |
| Hourly aggregated statistics | 90 days |
| Daily aggregated statistics and conversions | 24 months |
| Backups | 7 daily and 4 weekly; excluding the technical log from backups is being rolled out |

### 13.4 Artificial intelligence

If the Customer uses our AI assistant, it works on the **analytics reports**: aggregated figures and breakdowns, including the values of the conversion properties configured by the Customer. It does not build visitor profiles. Inference takes place in the EU (Scaleway, France) with no retention by the provider and no model training.

## 14. Minors

Our services are not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly process their data as platform users.

## 15. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top. If the change is significant, we will notify registered users by email before it takes effect.
